field_rule:
Flora field cue (Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas, p. 1239) — Under Andropogon virginicus, the Flora describes usually straw-colored sheathing bracts around flowering branches 2–3 cm long. Follow several branches to see how they are spaced.

Follow one attached upper culm, not its winter color. Broomsedge is a warm-season tufted perennial; its narrow flowering units are commonly 2–5 short rames per spathe, mostly 1–3 cm long. Panel 1 shows gross flowering hairs, but cannot prove the number or attachment of individual rames.
